prompt:
The same Berlin corner, vertical frame, wide. The young man in the navy blue
polo shirt and beige chinos stands still on the grey pavement slabs at the
kerb, seen from behind, waiting at a pedestrian traffic light on a bare grey pole, its
black housing holding two round lenses, the upper one lit and glowing an
even plain red. On the road beside him a cyclist in a BRIGHT YELLOW waterproof
jacket on a dark grey bicycle rides into the crossing, seen from behind. The
pale cream facade and the black parked bicycles along the street. Daylight,
overcast and flat.
